title: GenerationClusterResponse
description: Parsed LLM output for llm.generation.cluster: candidate implementation for a function cluster, extending llm.generation.function with cluster coordinates.

entity_target_id.description: EntityId or cluster handle of the cluster being generated.

candidate_source_bytes.description: Base64-encoded source bytes for the cluster candidate.

cluster_member_order.description: Ordered member entity IDs within the cluster.

initialization_order.description: Initialization order for cluster members and their dependencies.

declarations_required.description: Declaration entity IDs or artifact references required to compile this cluster.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made while generating the cluster.

dependencies.description: EntityIds or artifact references this cluster depends on.

unsupported_behavior.description: Behavior the cluster implementation explicitly does not handle.

proposed_tests.description: Test IDs proposed for this cluster.

source_evidence_references.description: Evidence references used to derive the cluster.
